compiled_state.title: Telemetry adapter framework + first-party emitters + language stack starter pack
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

Telemetry pipeline (Epic 2) defines the central store; this epic delivers the producers. The pipeline must be tool-agnostic — not hardcoded to any specific tool — so adding new tools (or new languages) is a drop-in operation, not a code change.

## Scope

Tool-agnostic adapter framework: adapters discovered by filename convention (`plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry-adapters/<tool_id>.sh` plus host-project overrides under `.dso/telemetry-adapters/`). Each adapter reads its tool's native output and emits canonical events with `tool_id` set. A single shared `sarif-to-canonical.sh` adapter handles any tool that emits SARIF natively (CodeQL, Semgrep, ESLint with `--format sarif`, Bandit, etc.).

First-party emitters: `dso-llm` (per-cycle findings with `cited_lines`), `dso-resolver` (resolver outcome distribution wired into both local REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md path AND CI path so events survive the local↔CI boundary).

First-class stack starter pack: `ruff`, `mypy`, `bandit` (Python), `eslint`, `tsc` (Node/TypeScript), `rubocop`, `brakeman` (Ruby). All adapters wrapped with `|| true` semantics so telemetry endpoint failures never fail-close a CI tool job. Tools' own blocking semantics (e.g., ruff exit code) remain the only gating signal.

## Approach (to be brainstormed)

- Define the adapter contract (input: tool native output via stdin; output: canonical JSONL via POST to `telemetry.endpoint`)
- Implement `sarif-to-canonical.sh` accelerator
- Implement `dso-llm` and `dso-resolver` emitters (in REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md + `review-fix-dispatch.md`)
- Implement first-class stack adapters
- Wire each existing CI tool job to invoke its adapter as a final step

## Dependencies

- Epic 2 (telemetry endpoint must exist and accept canonical events)

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>`.
